clue.text: Succeeded in prize song

indicators.note: the letter for succeeded sits inside the word for prize

parts.note: the palm is a traditional emblem of victory, so a prize
S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Someone wins an award for a song they composed.
explanation.definitionFit: A sacred hymn from the biblical book is a kind of song.

clue.text: One helps to look up translation of prose epic

indicators.note: translating reworks the words, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A scholar uses a reference to check a version of an epic poem.
explanation.definitionFit: A submarine's optical tube lets the crew look up above the surface.

clue.text: Benefit from molten rock surrounding one when climbing

indicators.note: in a down clue, climbing means reading upwards, in reverse
the rock word goes round the numeral

parts.note: lava is molten rock
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone profits from lava flowing round a climber.
explanation.walkthrough: LAVA round I gives LIAVA, read upwards in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: To avail is to be of benefit or use, as in 'to no avail'.

clue.text: Fail to observe our island state

parts.note: to miss something is to fail to notice it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone overlooks their own island nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Missouri is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: Try and be involved with second witness

indicators.note: letters that are involved get tangled up, so the three words are reworked

explanation.surface: Advice to a second person to get involved as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' rearranges TRYANDBE to BYTANDER, and S goes after the BY.
explanation.definitionFit: An onlooker who sees an event happen is a witness to it.

clue.text: Spare tree, if pollarded

indicators.note: a pollarded tree has its top cut off, so in a down clue the first letter goes

parts.note: ebony is a tropical hardwood tree

explanation.surface: An extra tree remains if its crown is cut back.
explanation.definitionFit: Spare can mean lean and thin, as is a bony figure.

clue.text: Dodgy permits allowing importation of prime whale product

indicators.note: the rearranged letters let another word in among them
dodgy means unreliable, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: ace means first-rate, prime

explanation.surface: Suspect licences permit top-grade whale oil to be imported.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dodgy' looks like it describes the permits, but it is the anagram signal; 'allowing importation of' then lets the word for prime in among the scrambled letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Spermaceti is a waxy substance taken from the head of the sperm whale.

clue.text: Girl in a new set having a following

indicators.note: the second a follows the rest

parts.note: to gel is to set, as jelly does

explanation.surface: A girl in a fresh crowd attracts admirers.
explanation.definitionFit: Angela is a common female given name, an example of a girl's name.

clue.text: Quote about Conservative, put down to be raised in debate

indicators.note: in a down clue, raised means read upwards, reversed
the quote word goes round the party abbreviation

parts.note: to cite is to quote
laid means put down

explanation.surface: A Tory politician's remark is quoted and dismissed in a parliamentary debate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be raised' reverses the whole build in this down light; 'in' is only a link before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Dialectic is the art of logical debate and discussion of ideas.

clue.text: Decline to eat a second course

indicators.note: the decline word takes the others inside it

parts.note: to rot is to decay or decline

explanation.surface: Someone refuses a second helping at dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A roast is a main course of a meal.

clue.text: Some intelligence on the way?

parts.note: the clue reads as news arriving, but means the good sense a driver or walker needs on the roads

explanation.surface: Information is about to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the alertness and judgement needed when using roads, a kind of practical intelligence.

clue.text: Back a horse, keeping another in the country

indicators.note: the reversed letters hold another letter between them
to back here is to read the next words in reverse order

parts.note: a nag is an old horse
H is slang shorthand for heroin, itself slang horse, so another horse

explanation.surface: A punter backs a horse while holding on to a second one in a rural setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' reverses A NAG to GANA; heroin is 'horse' in drug slang and H in shorthand, which goes in after the G.
explanation.definitionFit: The West African nation is a country, the clue naming it generically.

clue.text: Toilet located in hospital room

indicators.note: the word for toilet is placed inside the word for hospital

parts.note: SAN is short for sanatorium, a kind of hospital
LOO is British slang for a toilet

explanation.surface: A lavatory is found inside a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: A saloon is a public room, as in a bar or on a ship.

clue.text: As author, chap's about to relate story from the East

indicators.note: in an across clue, reading from the east means right to left, backwards
the chap's name wraps round the verb

parts.note: Tom is a typical chap's name, here with its possessive
to tell is to relate a story

explanation.surface: Someone poses as a writer to narrate an oriental tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from the East' reverses the whole build. Tobias Smollett was an 18th-century Scottish novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Tobias Smollett wrote picaresque novels such as Roderick Random, so he is an author.

clue.text: Judge in fix, disregarding leader's subtle improvement

parts.note: a ref, referee, judges a match

indicators.note: the first letter of the fixing word is ignored

parts.note: cement fixes things together

explanation.surface: A judge in a tight spot overlooks a leader's improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: Refinement is a small change that improves something.

clue.text: Money running short blocking old church event

indicators.note: the shortened money word blocks the gap between the other two pieces

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: the last letter of the money word is dropped

parts.note: currency is money in circulation

explanation.surface: Lack of funds stops an ancient church holding a function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocking' puts the shortened money word between the abbreviations for old and church; 'running short' drops its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that occurs, a happening, is an event.

clue.text: Oversight in the nursery?

parts.note: oversight here is supervision, not a mistake: looking after little ones

explanation.surface: A mistake made in a plant nursery.
explanation.definitionFit: Supervising young children is the work of nursery staff.

clue.text: Letter from Greece about new volcano

indicators.note: the Greek letter goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: eta is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A letter posted from Greece reports on a new volcano.
explanation.definitionFit: Etna is the active volcano on Sicily.

clue.text: An improper action, keeping time free

indicators.note: the first two pieces hold the time letter between them

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
taking a liberty is acting improperly

explanation.surface: An offence committed while serving time.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means unrestrained or not confined, a synonym for free.

clue.text: Drug was most powerful was like electricity, judging by the sound

definitions.text: was like electricity, judging by the sound

parts.note: crack is a form of cocaine
led means was in front, the strongest

explanation.surface: A drug was most powerful and buzzed with energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Electricity sparking makes sharp snapping noises, so it crackled.

clue.text: A way out object no longer?

parts.note: ex- means former, no longer so
it is an object pronoun, standing for a thing

explanation.surface: Asking whether a way out is something no longer needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A door marked with this word is a way out of a building.

clue.text: After reorganisation, I lost chair of Ancient Studies

indicators.note: the following letters are reorganised into a new order

explanation.surface: A professor loses their chair in a departmental restructuring.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to history, the study of ancient times, is what the adjective means.

clue.text: Agree it's not necessarily how recipient views it?

definitions.text: not necessarily how recipient views it
definitions.meaning: read as two words, 'as dispatched', which may differ from what arrives

explanation.surface: Someone doubts a message reads as the sender intended.
explanation.definitionFit: To give consent is to agree, and the split phrase describes something in its dispatched form.

clue.text: Teams rejected favourite dodge

parts.note: sides are teams in a game

indicators.note: the word for favourite is turned back

parts.note: a pet is a favourite, as in teacher's pet

explanation.surface: Teams turn down the favourite and evade the issue.
explanation.definitionFit: To step aside from a question or blow is to dodge it.

clue.text: Stops old restriction on women?

definitions.meaning: ... as a verb means stops or halts
a corset was once called by this word

explanation.surface: An old rule on women ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Stays stop things moving, and stays were an old corset restricting women.

clue.text: Endless terror presented by a black beetle

indicators.note: the word for terror loses its last letter

parts.note: a scare is a moment of terror
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A dark beetle causes endless fright.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarab is a dung beetle sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Irascible fictional boatman?

definitions.meaning: the water rat in The Wind in the Willows who loves messing about in boats

explanation.surface: A grumpy imaginary ferryman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ratty is British slang for bad-tempered, and the rat of the children's novel is fond of boats.

clue.text: Cut down something to wrap round area of wound

indicators.note: the wrapping word is shortened by losing its last letter

parts.note: a scarf is wrapped round the neck

explanation.surface: A bandage is cut to wrap round a wound.
explanation.definitionFit: A scar is the mark left where a wound has healed.

clue.text: Heads of Art and Woodwork are informed

indicators.note: the first letters of the next three words are taken

explanation.surface: School department heads are kept up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: Being aware means knowing about something, being informed.

clue.text: Steps taken to avoid fixed flight arrangements?

definitions.text: Steps taken to avoid fixed flight arrangements?

parts.words: Steps taken to avoid fixed flight arrangements?
parts.note: reads like travel planning, but describes moving stairs taken instead of a static flight of steps

explanation.definitionFit: A moving staircase is a set of steps that spare you a fixed flight of stairs.

clue.text: Engineering protects a member of the audience

indicators.note: engineering something means contriving it, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Building work shields a person in the audience.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectator watches a show or match, one member of its audience.

clue.text: Impresario's opening half may be handed to him on a plate

definitions.meaning: Richard ... Carte, impresario of Gilbert and Sullivan, has a double surname whose first half is wanted

definitions.text: may be handed to him on a plate
definitions.meaning: a small lace mat served under cakes on a plate, in an old spelling

explanation.surface: A theatre producer is offered something on a platter.
explanation.definitionFit: The old spelling of the lace mat put on plates matches the first part of the impresario's surname.
